title: Introducing Criteo Tech
body_markdown:
### Introducing Criteo Tech: *Explore the ideas, projects, and people behind Criteo’s technology.*


Technology at Criteo is shaped by the engineers, researchers, and communities who build, experiment, learn, and share every day.


[tech.criteo.com](https://tech.criteo.com/) brings more of that work together in one place. It is a dedicated destination for exploring technical articles, engineering stories, research, career journeys, and insights from across Criteo Tech.


The site also makes it easier to discover the wider Criteo Tech ecosystem, with links to key initiatives and resources such as the Criteo AI Lab and our Open Source projects.


This is only the beginning. Over time, the website will feature more of the people and activities behind our technical community — including events, talks and recaps, Tech Ambassador stories, and other ways Criteos contribute to technology inside and outside the company.


Whether you already follow our work or are discovering Criteo Tech for the first time, we invite you to explore[tech.criteo.com](https://tech.criteo.com/) and see what our teams are building, researching, and sharing.


[Criteo Tech | Engineering, AI & Research](https://tech.criteo.com/)
